entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a jersey. The ProFit one. It's the wrong size.
I understand. And when you say the wrong size, could you be a bit more specific? That will help me see if we have a better fit for you.
It's just too tight across the shoulders. That's all.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. A proper fit is definitely important. Would you be interested in an exchange for a larger size? We could get that sent out to you right away.
No. I just want to return it.
Not a problem. I can process a return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the ProFit Jersey, delivered on December 5th. Let me just check our policy.
Alright, I've confirmed it. Since your purchase was delivered about 30 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. I've gone ahead and approved your return.

I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. And since you're one of our VIP members, I've also waived the return fee and added a $10 credit to your account for your next purchase, just as a thank you for your loyalty.
Whatever. I guess that's better than nothing.
You should see the email in your inbox shortly. Once we receive the jersey, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
